text_block_list.text:
At No Reason's request, we visited an interactive history
theme park today. There was an attraction where you could
roleplay as a Sengoku-era daimyo, and...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I am the Daimyo――!!
choice_data_list: Then I'll play the senior retainer, the 'Karo'.
Then I'll play the senior retainer, the 'Karo'.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm!
You may serve me to your heart's content~♪

text_block_list.name: Spy
text_block_list.text: My Lord! It appears the neighboring domain is preparing for war!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, you've got some nerve baring your fangs at me!
...Right?
choice_data_list: Ha! Preparations for battle are already complete!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Is that so!
Then hear me, everyone! To battleeee!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Gwahahaha!
I shall crush the enemy camp just like this~~!"
choice_data_list: My lord! Enemy reinforcements are closing in on us!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, well done reporting this!
Then we retreat! We shall intercept them with our backup plan!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nya-ha-ha-ha!
How delightful, how utterly delightfuuul!
choice_data_list: This is fun for me too—it's like I'm really serving a genuine feudal lord!
This is fun, I feel like I'm really serving a real daimyo!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm-mm!
Thy fine efforts were truly splendid!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: You always anticipate what I want to do and prepare it in advance, after all~♪
And just as we were peacefully strolling through the theme park—!!
Prepare to forfeit your life!!

Out of nowhere, a ninja appeared right before my eyes!
Before I knew it, a whole squad of ninjas surrounded us from behind!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Who in the world are you lot?!

text_block_list.name: Ninja
text_block_list.text:
I have no obligation whatsoever to tell you!!
Prepare to become rust upon my blade--!!
choice_data_list: Look ou—t!!

text_block_list.text: (SLASH!!)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Lord <username>...?
choice_data_list: P-Please run away... *collapses*

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Lord <username>ーーー!!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Sob, sob...! To think you would perish just to shield me... *sniff*!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"However, I shall not yield! Nor shall I flee!
What kind of daimyo would I be if I did not avenge my loyal retainer?!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I'll slash them, slash them, and slash them to bits!
I'll make them your companions on the road to the underworld!

text_block_list.name: Ninja
text_block_list.text: "Laughable!! I will turn the tables on you!!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Take thiiiiiis!!
This is for Lord <username>~~!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ahaaa! So satisfying, so satisfying♪
I have successfully avenged thee!
choice_data_list: I'm glad I was able to protect our lord too!
I'm glad I was able to protect my Lord too!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Even if it was just the park's surprise performance,
to put yourself on the line to protect me!
I truly am beloved, aren't I~♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
When you shielded me back then,
you looked truly dashing, you know?
choice_data_list: Y-You think so~?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Heh...! I might just be a lucky gal after all, huh~?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
People are the castle, people are the stone wall, people are the moat.
Those who are brave and deeply loyal are an invaluable treasure.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I am glad.
Glad that you are by my side.
choice_data_list: No Reason...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oops, of course!
I must reward you for protecting your lord.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Trainer. Hast thou a wish?
I shall grant it, so long as it lies within my power♪
choice_data_list: In that case, I'd like to do some sword-fighting training!
Can I play the lord next time?
May I play the lord next time?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Trainer. Hast thou a wish?
I shall grant it, so long as it lies within my power♪
choice_data_list: In that case, I'd like to do some sword-fighting training!
Can I play the lord next time?
May I play the lord next time?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho~w!
In that case, allow me to show you the ropes!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on! Read the trajectory of the blade properly!
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah...!!
Y-Yeah...!!

text_block_list.text: Later on, I engaged in swordplay training with No Reason.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm-mm, splendid!
In that case—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: My Lord! It is treachery! The Akechi forces are here at Honno-ji...!!
choice_data_list: It can't be helped...!

text_block_list.text:
Later on, the two of us enjoyed playing
Sengoku warlords together with No Reason.
